applyTo: "**/*.f90,**/*.F90,**/*.f,**/*.F"

Follow the SFINCS Fortran coding style in [source/CODING_STYLE.md](../../source/CODING_STYLE.md) for every edit to Fortran source: bug fixes, new features and reformatting alike.

Before committing or opening a pull request, and when reviewing Fortran changes, also work through the review checklist in [source/CODING_REVIEW.md](../../source/CODING_REVIEW.md).
